slides.text: All of life is an inside job.
We must set the foundation of the intentions of our heart.
I will never be forgiven if I can't forgive myself.
I will never be loved if I can't love myself.
I will never be whole if I'm not whole in my soul.
I will never be rich if I'm not rich within myself.
I will never be beautiful unless I see the beauty within.
And I will never know God unless I see the God within me.
